== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-punishingone-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Punishing One (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): Same words. This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title and the text box set again; there is no “E” (the E in the lower border is gone), and a small round bronze disc sits at the bottom right, beside the game-text box.

The same area of the 2018 image, scaled to the slip's width, and the same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
